text: dhamme antarāyeva antaradhāpeti vūpasameti . idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti .pe. sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ . evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso 2 antarāyeva antaradhāpeti vūpasametīti . [288] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . seyyathāpi bhikkhave sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabandhāya cha māsāni udake pariyādāya hemantikena thalaṃ ukkhittāya vātātapaparetāni bandhanāni tāni pāvussakena meghena #1 po. ṭhānaso . evamupari . 2 ma.
